snippet.title: 5 API Performance Tips Every Backend Developer Should Know ⚡ | Caching, Compression & Pagination
snippet.description:
5 API Performance Tips Every Backend Developer Should Know  | Caching, Compression & Pagination

Want to build faster and more scalable APIs? In this short video, you'll learn 5 powerful API performance optimization techniques that every backend developer should know.

In this video:
    Caching – Reduce database load and dramatically lower latency.
    Connection Pooling – Reuse database connections for better throughput.
    Async Logging – Prevent logging from slowing down your requests.
    Compression (Gzip/Brotli) – Reduce response size by up to 70%.
    Pagination – Return smaller, predictable result sets.

These techniques are essential for developers working with:
    PHP and Laravel
    Node.js and Express.js
    Django and FastAPI
    Spring Boot
    REST APIs and microservices

If you're building high-performance backend systems, these API optimization strategies will help you improve speed, reduce server load, and scale efficiently.

snippet.title: Aadhar Card Pan Card Link
snippet.description:
As per Central Government of India (Income Tax Department – CBDT) guidelines, linking your Aadhaar Card with PAN Card is mandatory.
If your Aadhaar–PAN is not linked, your PAN may become inoperative, which can lead to:
• Higher TDS/TCS deductions
• Inability to file Income Tax Return (ITR)
• Tax refund delays
• Issues in investments, mutual funds, shares, and property transactions.
